name: How to Ensure Your Kitchen Island Project Stays on Track

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Site Measurement
step.text: This is where we begin to understand your vision and assess your space. We'll take precise measurements of your kitchen, noting existing doors, windows, appliances, and utility hookups. This phase ensures we have all the foundational data needed for accurate design and helps us identify any potential challenges early on. Typically, this happens over a few days as we gather information and discuss your needs.

step.name: Step 2: Design Planning and Layout Confirmation
step.text: Based on our measurements and your input, we develop CAD-supported layouts. This involves planning the island’s dimensions, seating, appliance placements, and lighting. We'll even mark the layout on your floor to visually test clearances, ensuring proper circulation—think 36 inches for basic passages, 42-48 inches for busy work aisles. This iterative design phase can take a few weeks as we refine the plan to your exact specifications.

step.name: Step 3: Material and Appliance Selection
step.text: With the layout confirmed, we move to selecting custom cabinetry, countertops, hardware, and any new appliances you wish to integrate. Our experience helps guide you through choices that enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value. This step is about making informed decisions that will define the island's look and feel, and lead times for custom items can vary significantly.

step.name: Step 4: Demolition and Rough-In Work
step.text: Once materials are ordered and delivered, our team begins any necessary demolition, followed by rough-in work for plumbing, electrical, or gas lines. This phase requires careful coordination and adherence to local requirements, performed by qualified tradespeople. It's often one of the quicker construction phases, typically lasting a few days depending on complexity.

step.name: Step 5: Cabinetry and Countertop Installation
step.text: This is where your island truly takes shape. We meticulously install the custom cabinetry, ensuring perfect alignment and fit. After cabinet installation, countertop templating occurs, followed by the precise installation of your chosen surface. Cabinet installation can take 2-5 days for in-stock options, or up to two weeks for fully custom pieces, with countertop installation often following within a week or two.

step.name: Step 6: Utility Connections and Final Adjustments
step.text: With the main structures in place, all utilities are connected, and final fixtures are installed. We then perform a thorough walkthrough, opening appliance doors and testing pulled-out stools to ensure all clearances are optimal and everything functions perfectly. This final phase, typically a few days, culminates in the final walkthrough, ensuring your complete satisfaction and a lasting impression.
